adopted_changes.name: deferred callee preflight
derivation: Original caller validates finite 0<=a<=10, 0<b<=1; this candidate only changes the existing a<=0.36,b<0.21 probe.

For x=a/2<=0.18, wh=x*x<=0.0324. The sinhc_half Horner coefficients are positive, the final high stage is RN(positive+1)>=1, and its low correction is bounded far below 1e-14. Conservatively sc.hi>=1-1e-14.

With b<a/16, d.hi=RN(a*sc.hi), q.hi=RN(C_hi*RN(b+0.5*d.hi)), r.hi=RN(d.hi/q.hi), z.hi=RN(r.hi*r.hi). C_hi=2.5066282746310007. Allowing 1e-12 aggregate relative slack gives z.hi>0.503, so the unchanged z.hi<=0.5 guard necessarily rejects.
If tiny inputs make high intermediates subnormal, q.hi is below the unchanged 1e-12 guard; division/square are never reached. Inputs surviving q.hi>=1e-12 have normal d,q,r,z in the ratio-bound case.
With RN(b+0.5*a)>=0.2, replacing a by d.hi changes the sum only by bounded relative error; q.hi>=C_hi*0.2*(1-1e-12)>0.5013. The unchanged q.hi<=0.5 guard necessarily rejects.
Passing preflight runs the identical original deferred body. Failing preflight skips a function which necessarily returned NaN, then resumes the identical dispatch order.
adopted_changes.work_skipped: Only probes necessarily rejected by unchanged q/z guards; surviving arithmetic and dispatch order unchanged.
adopted_changes.coverage_derivation: Frozen profile <4d rows (a,b,profile_output,reference_output), excluding earlier balanced successes and selecting original deferred domain. Evaluate only new binary64 guard predicates; profile confirms all balanced attempts succeeded.

adopted_changes.name: upper dyadic preflight
adopted_changes.domain: Guard evaluated only after solve rejects invalid/nonfinite inputs and a>=0.5; hence a in [0.5,10]. Successful original calls and arithmetic remain identical.
adopted_changes.derivation: ln(2)>0.5 gives exp(-a/2)>2^-a>=2^-ceil(a). Multiply by 0.5. ceil(a) is exact integer 1..10; conversion and subtraction are safe; biased exponent 1012..1021 is normal.
adopted_changes.rounding_note: ceil, cast and exponent bits produce exact dyadic threshold. Relative margin exceeds 10.1% for entire domain; original exp is still called whenever preflight permits.
adopted_changes.assembly: LLVM combines ceil and cast as fcvtpu. Adds 6 inline instructions after existing a>=0.5 branch: fcvtpu, mov dyadic base, sub with lsl #52, fmov, fcmp, branch. No saturation checks/helper calls. Saved upper-dyadic-small-solve.txt:100046018-10004602c.
adopted_changes.work_skipped: 747 of 2982 cap exponentials on each ordinary mixed population; 18.2373% of all calls. Original cap exp and b>0.5*cap retained after preflight.

adopted_changes.name: normal-price large logarithm
adopted_changes.domain: large::solve validates 10<a<1417, finite a and positive normal b.
derivation: General logdd receives dd(b) with +0 low part. Direct normal exponent/mantissa bit extraction replaces only its repeated frexp/scalbn steps.
Preserve threshold 0x3fe6a09e667f3bcd, exact power-of-two normalization, scalar m.ln(), and compensated two/scale/add sequence.
General logdd retained for gap/ratio inputs. No coefficients, degrees, iterations or derivative changes.

precision_test.name: normal_price_log_preserves_both_compensated_components
precision_test.comparison: Both hi/lo bits equal to general logdd(dd(b)).

adopted_changes.profile_coverage: All 4096 mixed_large cases dispatch to large::solve.
